Alex —

Per Mateo's ask, here is a concise pricing breakdown (numbers are illustrative until you confirm volumes):

1) One-time implementation charges (USD)
- Network peering/setup: $9,000
- HSM physical seat provisioning & configuration (per region): $4,500 x 6 regions = $27,000
- Audit log onboarding (first 30 days tooling & schema mapping): $3,000
Total one-time: $39,000

Concession option: apply a one-time credit of $19,500 (50% of total one-time) amortized across first 12 invoices if CareBridge signs a 12-month Dedicated + HSM commit by 2027-07-08.

2) Monthly recurring (USD/month)
- HSM seat operational fee (per region): $1,200 x 6 = $7,200
- Audit log ingestion (tiered): 0–250 GB/day = $2,000/mo; 250–1,000 GB/day = $6,000/mo; retention >12 months add+ $0.02/GB/month
- Residency infrastructure (reserved nodes + bandwidth): $8,500/mo
Estimated monthly recurring total (assume 200 GB/day): $17,700/mo

3) SLA credit mechanics (proposed)
- Measured against token-serving availability for your Dedicated pool per region.
- Credit = 5% of that region's monthly recurring for each hour below 99.95% availability, prorated.
- Credit cap = 100% of the region's monthly recurring for that month.
- Exclusions: scheduled maintenance windows, force majeure, or customer network issues.

Next steps: if you confirm audit log volume and whether retention >12 months is required, I will convert this into a table and draft the invoice line items. Also, we will draft the exact SLA credit language for legal review.
